para.label: Ordination note
para.as_written: بسم الله الخالق الحي الناطق / انما كان شرطن السيد الاسقف / انبا بطرس اسقف صيدنايا / في ثالث عشر مضت من شهر / تموز سنه ست الف وسبع ما[يه] / ثميه؟ لكون العالم الموافق / من سنين (العرب؟) ستمايه و (تمىـ؟) / (عشرة؟) / رحمنا الله بصلواته امين
translation: In the name of the living, creator, pronouncing God The master bishop anbā Buṭrus was ordained a bishop of Ṣaydināyā on the 13th of July of the year 6708?, that is 600? May God have mercy on us through his prayers
note: The scholar dates the ordination to 1200 CE and notes that the Hijri date is not accurate

program.label: Sinai Library Digitization Project, Phase 1
program.description: Digitized under the Sinai Library Digitization Project, Phase 1 (2018-2023), a collaboration of St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, with funding from the Arcadia Fund, the Ahmanson Foundation, and the Steinmetz Family Foundation. The project provided high-resolution images and basic description of the Arabic and Syriac manuscripts held in the Monastery’s library.
